en.transcript: You are approaching the resting place of Saint James the Greater. The Romanesque crypt beneath the high altar houses the silver reliquary casket containing apostolic relics.

es.transcript: Te acercas al lugar de descanso de Santiago el Mayor. La cripta románica bajo el altar mayor guarda la arqueta de plata con reliquias apostólicas.

name: Royal Chapel of the Holy Shroud

en.transcript: Entering the perimeter of the Guarini Chapel. The preservation reliquary contains the historic linen textile associated with the Passion narrative.

it.transcript: Stai entrando nel perimetro della Cappella della Sindone. Il reliquiario di conservazione custodisce il tessuto di lino legato alla narrazione della Passione.

en.transcript: You are entering the campus of Christ Cathedral. The glass-paneled sanctuary houses the diocesan reliquary collection and the Hazel Wright organ.
You are approaching the burial church of Saint Francis of Assisi. The stone crypt beneath the lower basilica contains the saint's sarcophagus reliquary.

it.transcript: Ti stai avvicinando alla chiesa sepolcrale di San Francesco d'Assisi. La cripta in pietra della basilica inferiore custodisce il sarcofago reliquiario del santo.
